hypothesis: An exact 2x2 texture gather reduces source-level V texture instructions for two tokens and two channels. It can remove part of the compact scalar ASTC latency gap without changing stored blocks or decoded values.
primary: compact hoisted v7 to paired gather v8, T8192, median ABBA/BAAB GPU ratio B/A <=0.85 in all five sessions
positive_criterion: At least 15% lower GPU time than hoisted v7 in every session, unchanged persistent memory, all twelve represented-value attention gates <=1e-4 and exact gather-versus-read checks passed.
secondary: Paired direct versus gather isolates the texture instruction change from the pairing/scheduling change. Own FP16 versus gather measures the remaining gap. No secondary comparison replaces the primary.
timing_design: Seeded ABBA or BAAB for each comparison, random comparison order per block, ten warmup command buffers per variant, retain every sample. Five separately launched sessions, shapes shuffled per session.
scope: Same compressed payload, normalized values, affine metadata and Q/K. Same persistent resources. Pairing changes reduction order. Source-level instruction count is not measured hardware instruction count or DRAM traffic. Precompressed warm repeated fixtures, not a model-quality, dynamic-cache or full-inference result. T2048 and T8192 repeat real fixture blocks.
